diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`helm_release.karpenter` declares an explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]`, but it already depends on `module.eks` implicitly through ordinary attribute references in its `values` block (`module.eks.cluster_name` and `module.eks.cluster_endpoint`). The explicit `depends_on` adds no ordering and can be removed.
